info.title: Bookly API
info.description: REST API for the Bookly service booking platform.

get.description: Returns users for admin management. Requires admin role.

post.description: Creates a user from the admin panel. Requires admin role.

get.description: Returns a specific user. Requires admin role.

put.description: Updates a user. Requires admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a user. Requires admin role.

post.description: Suspends a user account. Requires admin role.
Activates a suspended user account. Requires admin role.

get.description: Returns audit logs for system activity. Requires admin role.
Returns a specific audit log. Requires admin role.
Returns booking statistics and metrics for administrators.
Returns revenue statistics for administrators.
Returns provider statistics for administrators.
Returns service statistics for administrators.
Returns location statistics for administrators.
Returns services ordered by booking count.

post.description: Registers or updates an FCM device token for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns notifications for the authenticated admin. Requires admin role.
Returns the number of unread notifications for the authenticated admin.

patch.description: Marks an admin notification as read. Requires admin role.

get.description: Returns all soft-deleted locations. Requires admin role.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted location. Requires admin role.

get.description: Returns all soft-deleted services. Requires admin role.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted service. Requires admin role.
Create a new provider or customer account.
Authenticate a user and return a Sanctum Bearer token.
Revoke the current Sanctum token.
Revoke all Sanctum tokens belonging to the authenticated user.

200.description: Logged out from all devices successfully

401.description: Unauthenticated or current password is incorrect

post.description: Creates a booking using a booking slot and an idempotency key to prevent duplicate bookings.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for safely retrying the same booking request.

409.description: Booking conflict or duplicate idempotency request

booking_slot_id.description: ID of the available booking slot to move the booking to.

404.description: Booking or booking slot not found

get.description: Returns available time slots for a service, location, and date.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Location ID where the service is available.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date for which availability is requested.

get.description: Retrieve all available categories.

post.description: Create a new category. Available to admin and provider users.

403.description: Only admin and provider users can create categories

get.description: Retrieve a specific category by ID.

put.description: Update an existing category. Available to admin and provider users.

403.description: Only admin and provider users can update categories

delete.description: Delete an existing category. Available to admin and provider users.

403.description: Only admin and provider users can delete categories

get.description: Generates a CSRF token for the authenticated user and sets it in the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. The token must be sent in the X-CSRF-TOKEN header for state-changing requests.

503.description: One or more services are unavailable

get.description: Returns a paginated list of active locations.

post.description: Create a new location. Available to providers and administrators.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payments. Customers can only see their own payments, while administrators can see all payments.

post.description: Creates a payment for a booking using the configured payment gateway. Requires Sanctum authentication and an Idempotency-Key header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key used to safely retry the payment request without creating duplicate payments.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of payments for bookings associated with the authenticated provider.
Returns the details and current status of a payment. Customers can only access payments belonging to their own bookings.

404.description: Payment not found or does not belong to the authenticated customer

post.description: Receives payment events from the payment provider. This endpoint does not require Sanctum authentication. The request must include a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-Payment-Signature.

parameters.name: X-Payment-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature generated from the raw JSON request body using the configured webhook secret.

post.summary: Generate webhook signature for local testing
post.description: Generates the HMAC-SHA256 signature for the given webhook payload. This endpoint is available only in the local environment and is intended for testing the payment webhook from Swagger.

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID associated with the payment.

404.description: Endpoint is available only in the local environment

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated provider profile.

403.description: User is not authorized to access the provider profile
User is not authorized to update the provider profile

post.description: Create the profile for the authenticated provider.

403.description: User is not authorized to create a provider profile

get.description: Returns a paginated list of public holidays. Requires public_holiday:read ability.

post.description: Creates a new public holiday. Requires public_holiday:write ability.

country.description: Country where the public holiday applies.

description.description: Optional description of the public holiday.

get.description: Returns a specific public holiday. Requires public_holiday:read ability.

put.description: Updates an existing public holiday. Requires public_holiday:write ability.

delete.description: Deletes a public holiday. Requires public_holiday:write ability.

get.description: Returns public holidays associated with a specific location. Requires public_holiday:read ability.
Requires the schedule_exception:read ability.

post.description: Creates a schedule exception for a location. Requires the schedule_exception:write ability.

end_time.description: End time in H:i format. Must be after start_time.

get.description: Requires the schedule_exception:read ability.

put.description: Updates an existing schedule exception. Requires the schedule_exception:write ability.

end_time.description: End time in H:i format. Must be after start_time.

delete.description: Deletes a schedule exception. Requires the schedule_exception:write ability.

get.description: Returns schedule exceptions configured for a specific location.
Search services by keyword and optionally filter by location.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term. Minimum 2 characters, maximum 100 characters.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Optional location ID to filter services by location.

post.description: Create a service. Available to providers and administrators.

location_ids.description: IDs of the locations where this service is available.

put.description: Update a service. Available to providers and administrators.

location_ids.description: IDs of the locations where this service is available.

get.description: Requires the working_hour:read ability.

post.description: Creates a working-hour schedule. Requires the working_hour:write ability.

get.description: Requires the working_hour:read ability.

put.description: Updates an existing working-hour schedule. Requires the working_hour:write ability.

delete.description: Deletes a working-hour schedule. Requires the working_hour:write ability.

get.description: Returns working hours configured for a specific location.
Returns working hours associated with the locations where the service is available.

get.description: Returns the days of the week on which the specified location has no active working hours. The location must belong to the authenticated provider.
